OOriginalThetaProjection.both_tests_originalThetaLinear_PA_source_zero.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [addHaar.Regular] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) :
  have tests := ⋯;
  have A0 := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (DReview.sharp K phi) ⋯ ⋯;
  have A1 :=
    PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs
      (DReview.sharp K fun x => ↑(Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) * phi x) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S :=
    (JThetaAttachment.originalThetaLinear K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2)
            s).range.topologicalClosure.starProjection;
  have P := 1 - S;
  (P.comp A0).comp S = 0 ∧ (P.comp A1).comp S = 0
